### Type signature
```ts
items: Array<{ status: string } & Record<string, unknown>>
```
- Requires each element to have a `status: string` — the minimum contract the function needs.

### Implementation
```ts
items.reduce<Record<string, number>>((counts, item) => {
  counts[item.status] = (counts[item.status] ?? 0) + 1;
  return counts;
}, {});
```
- Single-pass `reduce` over the array — O(n), no intermediate allocations.
- `?? 0` initialises the counter the first time a status is seen; subsequent items just increment it.
